arithmetic_backend: Python exact integers/Fractions only; no Arb, FLINT, floating-point gates or producer imports.
log_method: 48-term positive atanh series with geometric remainder after power-of-two reduction
moment_method: Raw first/second moments and absolute centered third moment; differs from producer pairwise variance.
cross_check_scope: Fresh rigorous C<164 and all prime/exponent tails. Original higher-precision Arb enclosures overlap the independent dyadic enclosures; no claim to prove every original tighter endpoint by containment.
